threshold_selection_rule: First tested threshold achieving zero FPR while retaining the observed holdout recall; not production-approved.
training_data_status: Full raw DDoS CICIDS2017 CSV is not bundled; current model is the existing final artifact.
validation_status: Internal group-aware holdout benchmark only; not independent capture validation.
limitations: Current classifier detects BENIGN vs DDoS only.
No reliable timestamp/session identifier exists in bundled source files.
External-network generalization has not been demonstrated.
Unknown/OOD screening is a separate advisory layer and is not a validated unseen-attack classifier.
